meta.name: baoyu-electron-extract
meta.description: Extracts resources and JavaScript from any installed Electron app (`.asar` bundle), restoring original sources from `.js.map` files when available or formatting minified code with Prettier otherwise. Use when user wants to "extract Electron app", "decompile Electron", "get the source code of <app>", "inspect app.asar", "看 Electron 应用源码", "提取 .asar", or asks how a desktop Electron app is built. Skips `node_modules` and supports both macOS and Windows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: Claude 可以提取 Electron 桌面应用的资源与代码，还原原始源码或美化压缩代码。
howto.when: 当用户要求提取 Electron 应用、反编译、查看源码，或询问某个桌面应用如何构建时触发。

say.text: 帮我提取 Codex 的源码

say.text: 反编译这个 Electron 应用

howto.what_en: Claude can extract resources and JavaScript from installed Electron apps, restoring original sources from source maps or formatting minified code with Prettier.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to extract an Electron app, decompile it, view its source code, or inquire how a desktop app is built.

say_en.text: Extract the source code of Codex
say_en.note: Claude will search and extract the app's asar bundle.
Claude will ask for the app name or path.

say_en.text: Show me how VS Code is built
say_en.note: Claude will extract and display its source structure.
